biotools.summary: TyphiNET is an interactive online dashboard that allows users to explore Salmonella Typhi genotype and antimicrobial resistance distributions derived from publicly available pathogen genome sequences. It provides country-level summaries and temporal trends to inform typhoid control and intervention strategies.
